name: Egg Fried Rice
description: A quick wok-style stir-fry with soft egg and vegetables, using leftover cooled rice.
instructions: Cook rice ahead or use cooled cooked rice.
Scramble egg, stir-fry onion and carrot, add rice and soy sauce, then toss together.

name: Egg Bhurji
description: Soft Indian-spiced scrambled eggs with tomato and onion.
instructions: Chop onion and tomato.
Soften onion and chilli, add tomato and spices, then scramble in eggs until just set.
Finish with coriander.

name: Masala Omelette
description: A filling, lightly spiced omelette for breakfast or dinner.
instructions: Beat eggs with chopped onion, tomato, chilli and salt.
Pour into a warm oiled pan, cook until set, fold and serve.

name: Quick Egg Curry
description: Boiled eggs in a simple onion-tomato gravy.
instructions: Boil and peel eggs.
Cook onion, ginger and garlic, add tomato and spices, simmer to a thick gravy, then add eggs and warm through.

name: Masala Egg Toast
description: Crisp pan-toasted bread topped with seasoned egg.
instructions: Beat egg with chopped onion, tomato and salt.
Dip bread lightly, then pan-toast both sides until cooked through and golden.

name: Egg Dosa
description: A crisp dosa topped with spiced beaten egg.
instructions: Spread dosa batter thinly on a hot pan.
Pour beaten seasoned egg over it, add onion and coriander, cook until set and crisp.

name: Lemon Rice
description: Bright South Indian rice with mustard, peanuts, and curry leaves; timing assumes cooked rice.
instructions: Heat oil and splutter mustard seeds.
Add peanuts, curry leaves and turmeric, stir in cooked rice and salt, then finish with lemon juice.

name: Tomato Rice
description: Tangy tomato rice made with cooked rice and warming spices.
instructions: Soften onion with ginger and spices.
Add chopped tomato and cook until pulpy.
Fold in cooked rice and simmer briefly.

name: Curd Rice
description: Cooling yogurt rice with a gentle curry-leaf tempering, using cooked rice.
instructions: Mash cooked rice while warm and cool slightly.
Mix with yogurt and salt.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil and spoon over.

name: Vegetable Upma
description: Savory semolina with vegetables and a fragrant tempering.
instructions: Dry-roast semolina.
Temper mustard and curry leaves, soften onion and vegetables, add water and salt, then slowly stir in semolina until fluffy.

name: Kanda Poha
description: Fluffy flattened rice with onion, peanuts and lemon.
instructions: Rinse poha briefly and drain.
Temper mustard and peanuts, cook onion and potato until tender, add turmeric and poha, warm gently and finish with lemon.

name: Quick Idli
description: Steamed rice-and-lentil cakes made with ready fermented batter.
instructions: Pour prepared fermented idli batter into greased moulds.
Steam for about 12 minutes until set, then rest briefly before unmoulding.

name: Masala Dosa
description: Crisp dosa using ready fermented batter, with a quick potato and onion filling.
instructions: Boil and mash potato.
Temper mustard and curry leaves, soften onion, add potato and salt.
Spread batter thinly on a hot pan, crisp, fill and fold.

name: Sambar Rice
description: Comforting rice and lentils with vegetables and tamarind.
instructions: Pressure-cook dal until soft.
Simmer vegetables with tomato, tamarind and sambar powder.
Stir in dal and cooked rice, adjust water and simmer until creamy.

name: Coconut Chutney Toast
description: Toast with a quick coconut chutney and fresh herbs.
instructions: Blend coconut, coriander, chilli, salt and a little water.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil and mix in.
Serve with toasted bread.

name: Aloo Paratha
description: Pan-cooked flatbread filled with spiced potato.
instructions: Boil and mash potato; mix with onion, coriander and spices.
Fill rolled dough, seal and roll gently.
Cook on a hot griddle with a little oil until golden on both sides.

name: Chana Masala
description: Chickpeas simmered in a tangy tomato masala.
instructions: Soften onion with ginger and garlic.
Add tomato and spices and cook to a paste.
Add cooked chickpeas and water; simmer until thick.

name: Dal Tadka
description: Everyday lentils finished with a cumin and garlic tempering.
instructions: Boil dal with turmeric until soft.
Cook onion and tomato separately.
Pour over dal; sizzle cumin and garlic in oil and add as the final tempering.

name: Aloo Jeera
description: Crisp-edged potatoes with cumin and coriander.
instructions: Parboil and cube potatoes.
Toast cumin in oil, add potatoes, turmeric and salt, and pan-fry until golden.
Finish with coriander and lemon.

name: Paneer Bhurji
description: Crumbled paneer cooked with onion, tomato and spices.
instructions: Soften onion and chilli in a pan.
Add tomato and spices and cook until soft.
Crumble in paneer, warm through and finish with coriander.

name: Paneer Rice Bowl
description: A simple one-pan rice bowl with paneer and vegetables, using cooked rice.
instructions: Brown paneer cubes and set aside.
Stir-fry onion and capsicum, add tomato and cooked rice, season, then fold paneer through until hot.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Quick rice tossed with crunchy vegetables and soy, using leftover cooled rice.
instructions: Stir-fry finely chopped vegetables over high heat.
Add cooled cooked rice and soy sauce, toss until steaming and season to taste.

name: Vegetable Pulao
description: Aromatic one-pot rice with seasonal vegetables.
instructions: Cook onion and ginger with whole spices.
Add vegetables and rinsed rice, stir, add measured water and salt, cover and cook until rice is tender.

name: Besan Chilla
description: Savory gram-flour pancakes with onion and tomato.
instructions: Whisk besan with water, salt and spices into a pourable batter.
Stir in chopped vegetables.
Cook thin pancakes on a lightly oiled pan on both sides.

name: Masala Vegetable Sandwich
description: A toasted sandwich with spiced potato and vegetables.
instructions: Mash boiled potato with salt and spices.
Layer with sliced tomato, onion and capsicum between bread.
Toast on a pan until crisp and hot.

name: Quick Palak Paneer
description: Paneer in a simple spinach and tomato sauce.
instructions: Blanch spinach briefly and blend.
Cook onion, garlic and tomato with spices, add spinach puree and simmer.
Add paneer cubes and warm gently.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
description: A fast rice stir-fry with cooked chicken and vegetables, using leftover cooled rice.
instructions: Cut chicken small and stir-fry until fully cooked.
Add carrot and egg, scramble, then toss in cooled rice and soy sauce until piping hot throughout.

name: Home-style Chicken Curry
description: Chicken simmered in a straightforward onion-tomato gravy.
instructions: Brown chicken pieces.
Cook onion, ginger and garlic until golden, add tomato and spices, then chicken and water.
Cover and simmer until chicken is fully cooked.

name: Chicken Keema Bhurji
description: Minced chicken cooked dry with tomato and warming spices.
instructions: Cook onion, ginger and chilli until soft.
Add minced chicken and break it up.
Add tomato and spices; cook until chicken is fully done and mixture is mostly dry.

name: Chicken Masala Rice
description: A filling one-pot rice with chicken and mild spices.
instructions: Brown small chicken pieces and set aside.
Cook onion, ginger, tomato and spices.
Add rinsed rice, chicken and water; cover and cook until rice and chicken are done.

name: Pepper Chicken
description: Quick pan chicken with black pepper and curry leaves.
instructions: Cut chicken into small pieces.
Temper curry leaves, cook onion and ginger, add chicken, pepper and salt; stir-fry covered until cooked through, then uncover to dry.
